page_head.title: A family business built in the field
page_head.intro: NC Falcon was founded by the Falcon family in North Carolina, on more than 20 years of real electrical industry experience.

mission.title: Dependable manpower. Steady opportunity.
mission.lead: NC Falcon provides dependable electrical manpower solutions for contractors while creating consistent work opportunities for skilled electricians.
mission.text: As a family-owned business, we focus on relationships, communication, reliability, and flexibility. Our goal is simple: help contractors solve their manpower challenges while giving electricians the steady work and professional growth they deserve.

paragraphs.text: NC Falcon was founded by the Falcon family in North Carolina and built from real experience in the electrical industry.
Ownership brings more than 20 years of electrical experience, while the next generation continues to grow the business through recruiting, contractor relationships, and workforce development.
We've placed more than 100 electricians over time and keep roughly 20 actively working — recruited primarily through referrals, industry connections, and word of mouth.

cards.title: Relationships
cards.text: We build long-term partnerships, not one-off transactions.

cards.title: Reliability
cards.text: When we commit, we show up. Every time.

cards.title: Communication
cards.text: Clear, direct, and responsive — no runaround.

cards.title: Flexibility
cards.text: We adapt to your project, your timeline, your needs.

cards.title: Hard Work
cards.text: We come from the field. We respect the work and the people who do it.

cards.title: Opportunity
cards.text: Steady work and real growth for the electricians we place.

cards.title: Family-Oriented
cards.text: A culture built on trust, loyalty, and treating people right.

cards.title: Craft
cards.text: Skilled electrical work, done safely and done right.

points.text: Deep industry experience and field knowledge

difference.title: You're working with people, not a portal
difference.lead: When you call NC Falcon, you reach the people who run the company and know the trade.
difference.text: That means faster decisions, honest answers, and crews matched to your project by people who've actually done the work. We're small enough to care and experienced enough to deliver.

members.title: Ownership & Operations
members.text: The Falcon family founder and ownership team — 20+ years of electrical experience guiding every decision.

members.title: Business Development
members.text: Melvin Falcon — contractor relationships, recruiting, business growth, and industry networking.

members.title: Office Administration
members.text: Our office team handles incoming calls, scheduling, follow-up, and support for contractors and applicants.

future.title: Growing with the trades
future.text: Our focus today is 100% electrical staffing. As we grow, we're building toward additional trades — so contractors can rely on one trusted partner for more of their workforce needs.
